name: rpgmv-modkit
description: Modkit monorepo for RPG Maker MV/MZ games: runtime trainers, save editors, data codecs, and shared UI components.

scripts.build:web: npm run build -w tsw-save-edit && npm run build -w tsw-save-edit-pro
scripts.build:save-editors: npm run build --prefix zs2-modkit/app/save-editor && npm run build --prefix nwr-modkit/app/save-editor && npm run build --prefix dq2-modkit/app/save-editor
scripts.build:gui: npm run build --prefix zs2-modkit/app/gui && npm run build --prefix nwr-modkit/app/gui && npm run build --prefix dq2-modkit/app/gui
scripts.build: npm run ui:build && npm run build:web && npm run build:save-editors && npm run build:gui && npm run build:bridge
